description: Herschel dust column-density maps for the net9010 mom0 (column density only) model. Paths are relative to obs_dir. Distances and beams are ASSUMPTIONS taken from the release papers; edit them here.

notes.units: the mom0 input is ln(Sigma / <Sigma>_tile), so any map proportional to N(H2) works: N(H2) in cm^-2 or the 353 GHz optical depth tau (Herschel-Planck maps). Only the zero point matters: background/foreground subtraction changes the contrast.
notes.resolution: HGBS low-res maps 36.3 arcsec (SPIRE 500), high-res 18.2 arcsec (SPIRE 250, Palmeirim et al. 2013 App. A). The pixel grid oversamples the beam (3-6 arcsec pixels); regrid so the beam spans ~2 pixels before tiling, or tiles cover only ~0.1-0.3 pc.
notes.matching: for the CO comparison, use regions covered by both: Perseus (FCRAO), Ophiuchus L1688 (FCRAO OphA), Orion A (NRO), Taurus L1495 (CfA 12CO / FCRAO 13CO when ingested). Orion B, Aquila, Musca and Chamaeleon are dust-only.
notes.not_available: HGBS N(H2) maps of Perseus, Orion A, Serpens, Lupus, IC5146, Cepheus and Corona Australis are on the CEA archive (gouldbelt-herschel.cea.fr), which refused connections on 2026-10-26; IRSA holds only their band images. Perseus and Orion A use the Herschel+Planck maps of Zari et al. 2016 and Lombardi et al. 2014 instead.

perseus.alt_fits: perseus/planck_herschel_fit.fits (36 arcsec, full SED fit, 18 arcsec pixels); plane 0 = tau (header PLANE1), 9 arcsec pixels
perseus.source: Zari et al. 2016, A&A 587, A106 (CDS J/A+A/587/A106)

ophiuchus_L1688.source: HGBS, Ladjelate et al. 2020, A&A 638, A74 (CDS J/A+A/638/A74)

orionA.source: Lombardi et al. 2014, A&A 566, A45 (CDS J/A+A/566/A45); plane 0 = tau353 (header PLANE1), 15 arcsec pixels

taurus_L1495.source: HGBS, Palmeirim et al. 2013; Marsh et al. 2016 (IRSA HGBS)

orionB.source: HGBS, Konyves et al. 2020, A&A 635, A34 (CDS J/A+A/635/A34); Orkisz et al. 2017 give Ms ~ 6 from IRAM 13CO

aquila.source: HGBS, Konyves et al. 2015 (IRSA HGBS); distance 260 pc as in the release (436 pc from VLBA, Ortiz-Leon et al. 2017)

chamI.source: HGBS (IRSA HGBS); check the header for the resolution

chamII.source: HGBS (IRSA HGBS); check the header for the resolution

chamIII.source: HGBS (IRSA HGBS); check the header for the resolution
